title: Create with Rovo in the template gallery
description:
Save time when starting new projects by using Rovo to generate content directly from the template library in Confluence. This new capability allows you to quickly draft pages and structures based on your specific needs, helping you move from a blank template to a finished page faster than ever. To get started with this change Go to the Confluence template library (/wiki/templates)
